title: The Mumford--Tate group of a very general Lagrangian fiber
summary: For a primitive symplectic variety $X$ admitting a holomorphic Lagrangian fibration $f: X \to B$, we classify the possible Mumford--Tate groups of the very general fiber. We extract as a consequence that the discriminant of $f$ has codimension one in $B$. In the special case when $X$ is a hyper-Kähler manifold which is general among those admitting a Lagrangian fibration, and $b_2(X) \geq 7$, we further show that the very general fiber of $f$ is Hodge-generic.
